stages.name: Competitor Universe Definition
stages.input: Market data, customer data, analyst reports
stages.activities: Identify direct competitors, identify adjacent competitors, identify potential competitors, segment by competitive threat level, establish monitoring criteria
stages.successMetric: Competitor universe defined with 20-30+ competitors identified
stages.decisionPoints: Right competitors tracked? Threat levels appropriate? Emerging competitors identified?

stages.name: Continuous Monitoring Setup
stages.input: Competitor list, information sources, monitoring tools
stages.output: Monitoring system active across multiple sources
stages.activities: Set up automated news monitoring, set up website tracking, set up social listening, configure job posting tracking, establish sales intelligence collection
stages.tools: Monitoring platforms, news aggregators, social listening tools
stages.successMetric: Monitoring active for all competitors across 5+ sources
stages.decisionPoints: Monitoring comprehensive? Signal noise ratio acceptable? Alert frequency right?

stages.name: Intelligence Gathering & Analysis
stages.activities: Review monitoring alerts, conduct win/loss analysis quarterly, gather sales team feedback, synthesize insights, identify competitive threats, identify market opportunities
stages.successMetric: Quarterly competitive analysis with 3-5 key insights
stages.decisionPoints: Insights actionable? Threats real? Opportunities clear? Response strategy needed?
stages.qualityGate: Analysis complete, briefing prepared for leadership

stages.name: Competitive Intelligence Portal
stages.objective: Make competitive intelligence accessible to entire organization
stages.input: Competitive analysis, monitoring data, win/loss insights
stages.output: Intelligence portal with easy access for sales/marketing/product
stages.activities: Create competitive portal, document competitor profiles, create battle cards, document objection handling, establish search/access capabilities
stages.successMetric: Portal live with competitor profiles and battle cards for top 10 competitors
stages.decisionPoints: Portal easy to use? Content comprehensive? Adoption high? Update frequency sufficient?
stages.qualityGate: Portal live, team trained, adoption tracking started

stages.name: Competitive Alerts & Briefings
stages.output: Alert system and regular briefings active
stages.activities: Establish alert criteria for significant news, send urgent alerts to sales, create monthly competitive briefing, identify strategic competitive threats, brief leadership quarterly
stages.successMetric: Alert system active, briefings sent monthly
stages.decisionPoints: Alert frequency appropriate? Content actionable? Sales responding? Briefing cadence right?
stages.qualityGate: Alert system working, briefing cadence established

stages.name: Deal Selection for Analysis
stages.input: CRM data, closed deals, deal outcomes
stages.output: Deal list for interview with contact information
stages.activities: Identify recent wins for customer interviews, identify recent losses for customer/competitor interviews, ensure geographic/vertical balance, prioritize strategic deals
stages.successMetric: Deal list with 40-50 deals identified quarterly
stages.decisionPoints: Mix of wins/losses? Representative sample? Contact information quality?
stages.qualityGate: Deal list finalized, interview plan created

stages.name: Interview Coordination & Scheduling
stages.input: Deal list, contact information, interview guides
stages.activities: Contact customers/prospects, schedule interviews, brief interview team, prepare questions, organize logistics
stages.decisionPoints: Interview availability? Team prepared? Guide comprehensive? Incentives working?
stages.qualityGate: Interviews scheduled, team briefed, recordings planned

stages.name: Interview Execution
stages.input: Scheduled interviews, interview guides, recording setup
stages.activities: Conduct interviews, take detailed notes, record for reference, stay neutral and curious, explore decision drivers
stages.decisionPoints: Candid responses? Key insights gathered? Notes comprehensive? Recording quality?
stages.qualityGate: Interviews complete, recordings and notes organized

stages.name: Analysis & Insight Synthesis
stages.objective: Analyze interview data and identify patterns
stages.activities: Transcribe interviews, code responses by theme, identify patterns, analyze wins vs. losses, identify competitive differentiators, identify product gaps, identify messaging gaps
stages.decisionPoints: Patterns clear? Insights actionable? Product gaps real? Sales process issues?

stages.name: Insight Communication & Action Items
stages.objective: Share insights and drive action across organization
stages.output: Communicated insights with documented action items
stages.activities: Brief leadership, create executive summary, brief sales team, brief product team, identify action items, assign owners, track actions
stages.successMetric: Insights communicated to 3+ departments, action items assigned
stages.decisionPoints: Communication effective? Actions clear? Ownership assigned? Timeline reasonable?
stages.qualityGate: Insights communicated, action items assigned and tracked

stages.name: Research Planning
stages.input: Product segments, customer data, interview availability
stages.activities: Identify key personas needed, define research methodology, plan interview approach, identify data sources, establish timeline
stages.decisionPoints: Research comprehensive? Methodology sound? Timelines realistic?

stages.name: Data Collection
stages.objective: Gather qualitative and quantitative data on personas
stages.input: Persona research plan, interview guides, customer data
stages.output: Interview transcripts and notes with customer data
stages.activities: Conduct customer interviews, interview internal team, gather customer data, survey customer base, research industry analysts
stages.successMetric: 20-30 interviews conducted, survey of 100+ customers, internal team interviews
stages.decisionPoints: Interview diversity? Representative? Customer candid? Data quality?

stages.name: Pattern Analysis & Synthesis
stages.objective: Identify patterns and synthesize into personas
stages.input: Interview data, customer data, internal team input
stages.output: Persona profiles with demographics and psychographics
stages.activities: Code interview data by theme, identify demographic patterns, identify goal patterns, identify challenge patterns, identify success metric patterns
stages.successMetric: 3-5 distinct personas identified with clear differentiation
stages.decisionPoints: Personas distinct? Differentiation clear? Realistic? Data-backed?

stages.name: Persona Documentation
stages.objective: Document personas with rich detail and context
stages.input: Persona profiles, customer quotes, research findings
stages.output: Documented persona profiles with visual representations
stages.activities: Write persona narratives, create persona images, document goals/challenges/success metrics, document buying process, document concerns/objections
stages.decisionPoints: Documents comprehensive? Relatable? Usable by sales/marketing? Visual engaging?

stages.name: Persona Validation
stages.objective: Validate personas with customers and internal team
stages.activities: Interview customers to validate personas, gather sales team feedback, gather marketing team feedback, refine based on input
stages.successMetric: Personas validated by customers and sales team
stages.decisionPoints: Personas resonant? Recognized by team? Actionable?

stages.name: Persona Activation
stages.activities: Brief sales team on personas, update sales collateral with persona targeting, update marketing messaging by persona, create persona-specific content, establish persona usage metrics
stages.decisionPoints: Team adoption high? Content updated? Metrics tracked? Personas being used?
stages.qualityGate: Personas actively used in go-to-market efforts
